claim: Community objection themes for the Ratcliffe-on-Soar data centre layout
quote: Four assumed objection themes used to drive re-planning: noise, visual, buffer, and capacity.

cards.who_affected: Nearby residents with sightlines to the SE edge
cards.fix: Shift halls inward and keep battery/substation as a screen where useful

cards.who_affected: Residents within a few hundred metres of generators
cards.fix: Increase minimum generator–home distance across re-plans

cards.who_affected: Project sponsor and grid connection stakeholders
cards.fix: Keep halls and substation on site so IT load is preserved
